t: Saxophones - Thoughts on the Yanagisawa AWO20 Alto Sax?
s: September 27, 2017 - These instruments sound rich and warm down low and sweet higher up. I've moved to the AWO1 after handing over my stellar 1989 SA80II to my daughter. I would have happily kept that selmer for the rest of my time, but this new AWO1 has all the possibilities. All the AWO models seem identical in quality, and surprisingly they also feel about the same weight despite the differences in ribbing and metal.
